entities.name: Teedmar
entities.description: A dwarf mining town in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia, destroyed by the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Region of Dominaria containing the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Gurn Keep
entities.description: A keep armed with Teedmar's weapons.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Land bordering the area near Teedmar.

entities.name: Ebon Hand
entities.description: Agents who destroyed Teedmar with a volcanic eruption.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Witness of Teedmar's destruction from a dark bubble.

entities.name: Eliza
entities.description: Witness, with Reod Dai, of Teedmar's destruction.

entities.name: Tamun
entities.description: Present far underground with her mother Melelki during the destruction.

entities.name: Priest of Tourach
entities.description: Unnamed priest who created the dark bubble pocket realm.

events.summary: Worried by the strong weapons trade supplying Gurn Keep, the Ebon Hand sets off a volcanic eruption that destroys Teedmar completely.
events.quote: Setting off a volcanic eruption in the mountain next to Teedmar, the Ebon Hand destroyed the town completely.
